ns2:course.label: Advanced Food Chemistry
ns2:course.description: Emerging issues related to the chemistry of water, carbohydrates, lipids and proteins, as well as postharvest physiology and impact of processing on chemical reactions in foods. Prerequisite: Organic CHEM 232, or equivalent.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition department.
